title: ר' פנחס דדהובא

paragraphs: R' Pinhas de-Dehova. In Midrash Kohelet, on ‘Of laughter I said, it is mad.’ Do not let your heart mislead you into thinking this is a place-name: it is a scribal error, and should read ‘de-hokha me'arbev,’ ‘laughter confounds,’ etc. So it is in Vayikra Rabbah, Aharei 20:3.
